fieldNotes.truckGate: Single truck driveway off E 51st Ave is an open, uncontrolled apron - no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point control across the lane (Street View 2023-10, pano l4o8zBK14S9-X3Cj4xC22g). Property is chain-link fenced but the entrance opening is open.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth at the entrance. A freestanding info/check-in sign panel sits beside the drive, but no booth structure - consistent with a no-gate open site.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled gate; the sign by the drive is informational, not a gate-control kiosk.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~15 trailers backed into the west building face plus ~8-10 on the south face; estimate 25-30 total doors across faces. Band 25-50, count approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yards line the internal road on the west and the south aprons; well over 50 marked stalls / parked drop trailers visible.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two distinct building faces (west and south) suggest separate ship/receive clusters; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified in the truck path; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside Denver metro (Montbello/Gateway industrial district, NE Denver) - dense industrial/residential fabric nearby; Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Only the white dairy plant is on this property; the large tan distribution center to the east is a SEPARATE facility (different property line) and is excluded.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and ample internal paved width inside the open gate provide room for a bypass/express lane.
